title: Maple Air Fryer Delicata Squash
description: Caramelized delicata squash rings, air fried while the oven stays free for other dishes.
ingredients: 1 tbsp (15 ml) extra virgin olive oil
instructions: Halve 1 medium delicata squash (about 400g) lengthwise, scoop out the seeds, and slice into 1/2-inch half-moons (skin on — it's edible).
In a bowl, toss the squash slices with 1 tbsp (15 ml) extra virgin olive oil, 1 tbsp (15 ml) maple syrup, 1/4 tsp salt, and 1/8 tsp black pepper until evenly coated.
Arrange squash in a single layer in the air fryer basket, working in batches if it doesn't fit at once.
Air fry at 400°F for 12–15 minutes, flipping halfway through, until edges are caramelized and squash is fork-tender.
notes: Skin is edible, no peeling needed. Skip the maple for a lower-carb version — salt, pepper, and oil alone still caramelize nicely at this temp.
